cmd:
cd /opt/trading-bot/classic
TOK=$(grep GITHUB_TOKEN /etc/vps-github-bridge/token | cut -d= -f2)
cp classic_pos_html.py backup_be_pos_html.py
f=classic_pos_html.py
curl -sf -H "Authorization: token $TOK" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" "https://api.github.com/repos/ruslan591/weather-_Odessa/contents/bot/classic/$f" -o /tmp/new_$f || { echo FETCH_FAIL; exit 1; }
python3 -c "import ast;ast.parse(open('/tmp/new_$f',encoding='utf-8').read())" || { echo PARSE_FAIL; exit 1; }
cp /tmp/new_$f $f; chown tbot:tbot $f
systemctl restart classicbot; sleep 8; systemctl is-active classicbot
curl -s localhost:8091/ | grep -c "Дошли до БУ"
curl -s localhost:8091/api/runs | python3 -c "
import sys,json
d=json.load(sys.stdin);n=b=0
for r in d['runs']:
    for t in r['trades']:
        n+=1;b+=bool(t['be'])
print('сделок',n,'дошли до БУ',b)"
